jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring:
Principal Engineer for a hybrid project, 2 days per week on-site, in Lisbon or Porto.

About the Role

You will enable product teams to deliver software more predictably, efficiently and safely by combining deep full-stack engineering expertise with practical leadership of an AI-enabled SDLC. The role operates across teams, builds reference implementations, solves complex cross-stack problems, strengthens engineering standards and helps Tech Leads adopt repeatable AI-assisted practices with appropriate human validation and governance.
You will act as an individual contributor with cross-team influence and no direct people-management responsibility, working closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Engineering Management, Product, Quality Engineering, Security, Data and Platform teams. You move between strategic direction and hands-on delivery depending on the problem and level of technical risk.
The ideal candidate influences through technical credibility, clear reasoning and collaboration. You remain hands-on and demonstrate proposed approaches in working code, balance engineering ambition with pragmatism, and communicate complex topics clearly to engineering, architecture, product and leadership audiences. You create leverage by enabling others and value security, transparency, traceability and accountability in the use of AI.

Main Responsibilities:

Full-Stack Technical Leadership
Define and drive the React Native
technology roadmap, leading continuous improvement of the mobile app's performance, stability, security and release process.
Provide expert guidance across frontend, mobile, backend, APIs, integrations, data persistence, cloud, CI/CD, observability and production operations.
Lead technical discovery and engineering spikes for complex or high-risk initiatives.
Build and maintain reference implementations that demonstrate approved patterns and accelerate adoption.
Review designs and critical implementation decisions for scalability, maintainability, security, resilience and cost.
Help teams diagnose complex production and cross-system issues when normal escalation paths are insufficient.

Engineering Excellence and Enablement
Strengthen clean architecture, Domain-Driven Design, secure coding, automated testing, trunk-based development, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Contribute to clear Definition of Ready and Definition of Done criteria, with focus on technical readiness, testability and operability.
Create playbooks, templates, checklists and automation that make the preferred way of working easy to adopt.
Coach Tech Leads and engineers through pairing, design sessions, code reviews, workshops and communities of practice.
Promote pragmatic technical debt management, balancing delivery with long-term sustainability.

Architecture, Reliability and Security
Implement architecture principles in working software and provide feedback to the Lead Architect.
Champion API-first, event-driven and decoupled integration patterns when appropriate.
Embed security by design, threat-aware engineering and privacy considerations into delivery.
Advance application observability through structured logging, metrics, traces, alerting, service-level indicators and runbooks.
Guide and help improve resilience, recoverability and operability of critical services.
Support FinOps practices by guiding balanced cloud consumption and operational cost in design choices.

Requirements:

Mandatory
5+ years of relevant experience
Proven experience as Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Senior Tech Lead or equivalent senior individual contributor.
Strong frontend and mobile engineering expertise; production experience with React Native is a strong differentiator.
Demonstrable full-stack experience from user experience and client applications through services, integrations, data and cloud operations.
Experience influencing multiple teams without direct management authority.
Delivery in complex enterprise environments with security, auditability, resilience and regulatory constraints.
Evidence of introducing or scaling standards, reusable patterns or developer enablement capabilities.
Frontend & Mobile: very strong — React, React Native, modern web architecture, accessibility and performance.
Backend: expert in at least one stack — preferably .NET; Java or Node.js also relevant.
APIs & Integration: strong — REST, OpenAPI, gateways, asynchronous messaging, Kafka.
Cloud & Platform: strong — Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, infrastructure as code.
Delivery Engineering: strong — Git, CI/CD, GitHub, Azure DevOps or Jira, SonarQube.
Quality: strong — unit, integration, contract, end-to-end and performance testing.
Operations: strong — observability, incident diagnosis, secure operations and resilience.

Mandatory AI-SDLC Experience (concrete examples required, not only tool familiarity)
Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agentic coding tools in real delivery (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent).
Use of AI beyond code completion, including technical specification, tests, refactoring, review, documentation or incident analysis.
Experience defining validation controls, review practices and guardrails for AI-generated outputs.
Evidence of measurable change to delivery performance, quality, rework or developer productivity.
Ability to distinguish safe, high-value AI use cases from activities requiring stronger human control.

Need to speak Portuguese fluently

Nice to Have:
Experience in financial services, payments, credit, banking or another regulated industry.
Experience with customer-facing digital channels and high-volume transactional systems.
Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
Data: working to strong — relational and NoSQL stores, modelling, operational data and event streams.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary package
Meal allowance
Health insurance
Others

Interested?

Apply now or reach out to learn more we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications & Digital Products
jobs.description:
Job Description

About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.

About The Position

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a Software Engineer
to join our Applications & Digital Products Team.

Responsibilities

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

Design and develop cutting-edge services that will transform the hospitality industry in the UAE
Write clean code with high unit and integration test coverage
Perform code review, provide feedback, participate in design sessions
Conduct reviews of reliability, load testing, cost efficiency and security
Enable visibility of our services through metrics, dashboards and alerts
Promote and introduce best practices to continuously improve our solutions
Performs controlled resolution of incidents and problems including prioritization and escalation to relevant groups when appropriate, root cause analysis of all problems with follow through resolution
Ability to handle incidents, problems and change. Calm and analytical when faced with major incidents on critical systems
Implement and drive automation focused on productivity improvements
Exhibits sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information with inherent confidence with operations and technology partners on regional or global basis

About You

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

Strong proficiency (4+ years) in modern .NET/C#, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
Strong experience in distributed system architecture (microservices, event-driven, REST)
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS)
Strong knowledge of storage systems such as SQL Server, Redis
Proficiency in testing with focus on Automated end to end quality
Experience with Docker, Terraform, IaC, Kubernetes
Understanding of monitoring tools such as DataDog, NewRelic
Ability to work independently as well as in a group
Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, information technology, mathematics or related field

About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits

We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as incentive programs, and other employee benefits . The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicant s seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.
